investigation: One integrated controller, always including the original back pass. Up to three frozen development generations; preserve all results and inspect native behavior before a revision. Each revision uses its reserved fresh development seeds. Select and freeze a final source before using validation. No edits after validation.
selection: The integrated source must earn more raw development points than active and execute keeper back passes; otherwise inspect evidence and revise within the registered development budget, or retain active. Best development points-per-match improvement selects the frozen generation. The target is a large margin, not a guaranteed result.

gates.validation_points: strict improvement; whole-seed paired bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0

promotion: Keep main, my-team and archived champions unchanged; deliver the integrated candidate and actual results. Promotion requires evidence and owner approval.
requested_schedule: First half normal; second half moderate attack until the final 30 seconds, then ultra attack regardless of score. Standard 120 second match: 0–60s / 60–90s / 90–120s. Short matches preserve the entire first half as normal.
requested_spacing: Wider free support, minimum 7.5 units around the carrier and 6 units between selected targets. Existing verified recipients, keeper, chaser, cover, restarts and urgent recovery remain protected. Existing precision and physics checks determine actual passes.
